discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic peptide discovery to drugs that have changed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity and that show cardiovascular and renal benefits. The work has already won the Lasker, Breakthrough and Gairdner awards, which often come before a Nobel, and its clinical effect is now very large.
